summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Channel-Based Dynamic Column Layout on Restaurant POS Dashboard. All core features working correctly.

warnings.issue: React key warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' for walk-in orders (wc-730204, wc-529152, etc.)
warnings.details: Multiple walk-in orders have duplicate keys. This is a React warning, not a breaking bug, but should be fixed for proper reconciliation.

test_results.login_and_navigation: PASS - Login with owner@18march.com works, redirects to /loading then /dashboard
test_results.channel_columns_render: PASS - All 4 channels render (Dine-In, TakeAway, Delivery, Room) with headers showing channel name and order counts
test_results.right_arrow_increase_columns: PASS - Clicking > on Dine-In increases columns from 2→3→4→5→6→7→8 with NO upper limit
test_results.channel_independence: PASS - Clicking > on Dine-In does NOT affect TakeAway, Delivery, or Room column counts
test_results.left_arrow_decrease_columns: PASS - Clicking < on Dine-In decreases columns. At 1 column, left arrow is disabled
test_results.horizontal_scroll: PASS - Horizontal scroll appears when total width exceeds viewport (scrollWidth: 2528 > clientWidth: 1544)
test_results.resize_handle_exists: PASS - Resize handle (grey bar between channels) exists with data-testid='resize-handle'
test_results.order_view_arrows: PASS - Channel columns and arrows work in Order/List view
test_results.layout_reset_on_refresh: PASS - Layout resets to default (2 columns each) after page refresh

action_items: FIX (LOW): Resolve duplicate React key warnings for walk-in orders in DashboardPage.jsx channelData.dineIn.items
critical_code_review_comments: The duplicate key warning occurs because walk-in orders are being added to dineIn channel items with keys like 'wc-730204' that may already exist in allTablesList. Consider using a unique prefix or combining with channel ID.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data from external API
context_for_next_testing_agent: All channel column layout features are working correctly. The arrow buttons (< and >) work independently for each channel. No upper limit on column count. Left arrow disabled at min 1 column. Layout resets to default 2 columns on page refresh. The only issue is a React key warning for duplicate walk-in order keys which is cosmetic and doesn't affect functionality.
features_tested: Right arrow (>) increases column count with no upper limit
Left arrow (<) decreases column count with min 1 limit
Channel independence - arrows don't affect adjacent channels
Horizontal scroll when content exceeds viewport
